notes.title: update_27012025
notes.notes:
You'll laugh, but:
1. I lowered the difficulty of the easy difficulty level again, especially the first 10.
2. Added information about some game mechanics in the gang menu.
3. Slightly reworked the interface in the gang menu.
4. Added other small changes and improvements.
Sorry for not doing this before the release and making you suffer ;-)

   If you are waiting for some kind of signal to write a review... here it is! It's a little frustrating that there are only two reviews.
   Thanks to everyone who sends feedback (especially videos), it allowed us to make the games much better.
      With best wishes, yours, Ilya Gubin.

notes.title: update_24012025
notes.notes:
1. Minor bugs were fixed.
2. A small rebalance was made to the easy difficulty level in general and the first levels.
3. Information about some game mechanics was added (it is recommended to replay levels 2 and 3).
Enjoy the game! (feel free to leave a review :-) )
Best wishes, Ilya Gubin.
